1.sahih_international: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
1.pickthall: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
1.yusuf_ali: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-
1.shakir: Read in the name of your Lord Who created.
1.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), read in the name of your Lord who created (all things).
1.mohsin_khan: Read! In the Name of your Lord, Who has created (all that exists),
1.arberry: Recite: In the Name of thy Lord who created,

2.sahih_international: Created man from a clinging substance.
2.yusuf_ali: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:
2.shakir: He created man from a clot.
2.muhammad_sarwar: He created man from a clot of blood.
2.mohsin_khan: Has created man from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood).

3.sahih_international: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
3.pickthall: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
3.yusuf_ali: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-
3.shakir: Read and your Lord is Most Honorable,
3.muhammad_sarwar: Recite! Your Lord is the most Honorable One,
3.mohsin_khan: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous,
3.arberry: Recite: And thy Lord is the Most Generous,

4.yusuf_ali: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-
4.shakir: Who taught (to write) with the pen
4.muhammad_sarwar: who, by the pen, taught the human being:
4.mohsin_khan: Who has taught (the writing) by the pen [the first person to write was Prophet Idrees (Enoch)].

5.sahih_international: Taught man that which he knew not.
5.pickthall: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
5.yusuf_ali: Taught man that which he knew not.
5.shakir: Taught man what he knew not.
5.muhammad_sarwar: He taught the human being what he did not know.
5.mohsin_khan: Has taught man that which he knew not.
5.arberry: taught Man that he knew not.

6.pickthall: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
6.yusuf_ali: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,
6.shakir: Nay! man is most surely inordinate,
6.muhammad_sarwar: Despite this, the human being still tends to rebel
6.mohsin_khan: Nay! Verily, man does transgress all bounds (in disbelief and evil deed, etc.).
6.arberry: No indeed; surely Man waxes insolent,

7.yusuf_ali: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.
7.shakir: Because he sees himself free from want.
7.muhammad_sarwar: because he thinks that he is independent.

8.sahih_international: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
8.pickthall: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
8.yusuf_ali: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).
8.shakir: Surely to your Lord is the return.
8.muhammad_sarwar: However, (all things) will return to your Lord.
8.mohsin_khan: Surely! Unto your Lord is the return.
8.arberry: Surely unto thy Lord is the Returning.

9.sahih_international: Have you seen the one who forbids
9.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
9.shakir: Have you seen him who forbids
9.muhammad_sarwar: Have you seen the one who prohibits
9.mohsin_khan: Have you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) seen him (i.e. Abu Jahl) who prevents,
9.arberry: What thinkest thou? He who forbids

10.yusuf_ali: A votary when he (turns) to pray?
10.muhammad_sarwar: a servant of Ours from prayer?
10.mohsin_khan: A slave (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) when he prays?

11.sahih_international: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
11.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
11.yusuf_ali: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-
11.shakir: Have you considered if he were on the right way,
11.muhammad_sarwar: What will happen if the praying person is rightly guided
11.mohsin_khan: Tell me, if he (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) is on the guidance (of Allah)?
11.arberry: What thinkest thou? If he were upon guidance

12.muhammad_sarwar: or if he commands others to maintain piety!?

13.sahih_international: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
13.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?
13.yusuf_ali: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?
13.shakir: Have you considered if he gives the lie to the truth and turns (his) back?
13.muhammad_sarwar: What will happen if the prohibiting rejects the Truth and turns away from it!?
13.mohsin_khan: Tell me if he (the disbeliever, Abu Jahl) denies (the truth, i.e. this Quran), and turns away?
13.arberry: What thinkest thou? If he cries lies, and turns away -

14.sahih_international: Does he not know that Allah sees?
14.pickthall: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?
14.yusuf_ali: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?
14.shakir: Does he not know that Allah does see?
14.muhammad_sarwar: Does he not realize that God sees him?
14.mohsin_khan: Knows he not that Allah does see (what he does)?
14.arberry: Did he not know that God sees?

15.sahih_international: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
15.pickthall: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -
15.yusuf_ali: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-
15.shakir: Nay! if he desist not, We would certainly smite his forehead,
15.muhammad_sarwar: Let him know that if he does not desist, We shall certainly drag him by his forelocks,
15.mohsin_khan: Nay! If he (Abu Jahl) ceases not, We will catch him by the forelock,
15.arberry: No indeed; surely, if he gives not over, We shall seize him by the forelock,

17.sahih_international: Then let him call his associates;
17.pickthall: Then let him call upon his henchmen!
17.yusuf_ali: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):
17.shakir: Then let him summon his council,
17.muhammad_sarwar: Let him call on his associates for help
17.mohsin_khan: Then, let him call upon his council (of helpers),
17.arberry: So let him call on his concourse!

18.sahih_international: We will call the angels of Hell.
18.pickthall: We will call the guards of hell.
18.yusuf_ali: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!
18.shakir: We too would summon the braves of the army.
18.muhammad_sarwar: and We too will call the stern and angry keepers of hell.
18.mohsin_khan: We will call the guards of Hell (to deal with him)!
18.arberry: We shall call on the guards of Hell.

19.sahih_international: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
19.pickthall: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
19.yusuf_ali: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!
19.shakir: Nay! obey him not, and make obeisance and draw nigh (to Allah).
19.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), never yield to him! Prostrate yourself and try to come closer to God.
19.mohsin_khan: Nay! (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him))! Do not obey him (Abu Jahl). Fall prostrate and draw near to Allah!
19.arberry: No indeed; do thou not obey him, and bow thyself, and draw nigh.
